summary: Two copies of railroad still can't work together: the load-time error says so, but the UI stays inert
detail: 0.12's guard (signals.ts, 'One copy per page') logs an error naming both copies; it does not make them cooperate. The whole fix, only as one change: keep the tracking state (currentListener, currentDeps, batchDepth, activeFlush, pendingEffects, the dispose stack, the provider registry) on globalThis[Symbol.for('@blueshed/railroad@1')], and recognise a signal by that brand instead of `instanceof Signal`. A brand alone is worse than nothing: `{doc.data}` goes from a visible '[object Object]' to a silently stale value and when() still never switches, because .get() registers with its own copy's listener. Repro: link delta by `file:` so it brings its own node_modules/@blueshed/railroad, render `{doc.data}` and a when() on it. Until then the skill's 'Local development across repos' (pack tarballs, one copy) stands.

summary: Glitch-free only while computeds read the same signals every run: a computed that switches its reads can be seen half-updated
detail: Topological order is fixed at subscription depth; a computed like `flag.get() ? b.get() : a.get()` can deepen after its readers were ordered, so on a later write one reader may run once on half-updated values before it re-runs on the settled ones (every write still settles). The claim is narrowed in the signals.ts header, README, skill and CLAUDE.md. The real fix is push-dirty / pull-recompute (the colouring model of Preact signals, Vue 3.4, Reactively): a computed re-checks its sources when read. A randomized checker found 0 glitches on fixed graphs over ~107k runs and ~600 per 300 dynamic graphs; a 4-line partial ('notify readers when a computed deepens') left ~60 and added redundant runs, so it was not taken. Commit the checker with the fix.

summary: A .get() in a render body is a silent one-shot read: warn once in development
detail: Now possible, since render bodies (components, when()/list() renders, route handlers) run untracked: warn once per signal when .get() runs with no listener inside a render. It would catch the skill's §1 (no .get() in JSX children), §7 and §9 traps at run time instead of in review.

summary: "Repeat both lines after each change" keeps the old tarball: bun add again does not refresh it
detail: Tried on Bun 1.4.2 with a packed eta installed in an app (Workshop/japan-eta): after `bun pm pack` of a changed checkout, `bun add <the same .tgz path>` answers '1 package installed' and node_modules keeps the first tarball's files; `bun install --force` does too, since the lockfile holds them. What works: `bun remove <pkg> && bun add <tarball>`, or dropping bun.lock. Say so here; delta's reference has the same recipe (delta #41). Deleting node_modules/<pkg> and installing again brings back the same old copy too: the lockfile's integrity hash pins it.
